description: Passive check of a public web app (for example one built with Lovable, Bolt, v0, Cursor or Claude Code): downloads its page and the same-site scripts that page loads, exactly as a browser would, and reports secret keys in the public JavaScript (Supabase service_role, Stripe secret, OpenAI, Anthropic and others, redacted), public source maps, client-side Supabase/Firebase exposure and missing security headers. Never signs in, posts, probes paths or uses a key it finds. Use only on apps the user owns or is responsible for.

url.description: The public https address of the app, e.g. app.example.com.

name: check_app_exposure
title: Web app exposure check
